0022600196.text: The 76ers (8-2, first in the Atlantic and the East) come into this road game after a loss, with a 4-1 road record and an 8-2 mark over their last ten. The Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East, 5 games back in the Central) have lost six straight, and Philadelphia leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 126-107 win in Philadelphia on November 2, following a 1-2 series loss to Chicago in 2025-26. Philadelphia is without Adem Bona (back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back fracture), and Joel Embiid is day-to-day with plantar fasciitis and a game-time decision, while Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (hamstring strain) and Zach Collins (illness), with Jalen Smith and Tobe Awaka day-to-day and also game-time decisions.
